description: Car listings from AutoScout24 with identity, vehicle, price, consumption, location, dealer profile (email, VAT/UID, reviews, address, opening hours), EV/charging, engagement counters, media, equipment/history, and enrichment metadata. Fields that the source does not publish are omitted; CHF prices use priceAmount + priceCurrency=CHF and all other markets use EUR.
